title: Lazar held at gunpoint at Indian Springs but never fired

tellings.quote: they bring him to Indian Springs they put a gun to his head

plain: In 1989, Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada, was taken to Indian Springs, a small Nevada desert base, where a gun was put to his head, but he was never fired from his job. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells this, passing on what he heard from an associate of Lazar's named John Lear. If true, it shows how hard the people behind the work leaned on Lazar to keep him quiet.
